verdict.rationale: A changelog entry says developers can browse public checklist scores at manufact.com/mcp-catalog and run a readiness scan against any MCP URL, which gives a published score for comparing servers. The score comes from an automated audit of protocol compliance and platform readiness, with deployment history showing each deployment's latest checklist score. Evidence for the public catalog is a single changelog mention, and the other signal types are not shown for comparing third-party servers. Missing for 10: usage/install counts, public health or liveness indicators, verification badges, in-depth docs on the public catalog's comparison features, independent corroboration.
